articles.title: Xbox Cloud Gaming now lets your phone double as a controller on smart TVs
articles.excerpt: No controller? No problem.
articles.body: TL;DR A new Xbox Cloud Gaming preview lets you use your phone as a controller on supported smart TVs. It works with Android and iOS devices, and you don’t even need to download an app. Xbox is also previewing cloud connect for the Xbox Nano Controller in the US. Cloud connect lets the Xbox Nano Controller connect directly to cloud servers over Wi-Fi, which Microsoft says can help reduce input lag. Xbox Cloud Gaming is a convenient way to play Xbox games on your smart TV without a console. But what if you don’t have a controller handy? Microsoft is now trying to fix that by letting you turn your phone into an Xbox controller. The company announced two new Xbox Cloud Gaming previews yesterday. The first lets you use an Android or iOS phone as a makeshift controller on supported smart TVs.

articles.title: ¿Qué es Chain of Recall? Cómo los IDs estables dan memoria a los agentes de IA
articles.excerpt: ¿Qué es Chain of Recall? Cómo los IDs estables dan memoria a los agentes de IA Chain of Recall es una forma de dotar de memoria a un agente de IA de larga ejecución sin saturar su ventana de contexto.…
articles.body: ¿Qué es Chain of Recall? Cómo los IDs estables dan memoria a los agentes de IA Chain of Recall es una forma de dotar de memoria a un agente de IA de larga ejecución sin saturar su ventana de contexto. Cada Trigger, Thread y Worker recibe un ID estable. El contexto solo conserva los IDs, resúmenes breves y mensajes cercanos, y el agente recorre los enlaces entre identificadores para recuperar hechos anteriores en unos pocos saltos. Prueba Apidog hoy El término proviene del ensayo de diseño de DeepSeek Harness “Exploring Super-agent Design” , publicado el 01-11-2026. Una advertencia antes de continuar: el ensayo describe una arquitectura, no una funcionalidad lanzada al mercado.
articles.author: Roobia

articles.title: My URL-to-Markdown fetcher taught me that 'main content' is a guess until you give it a selector
articles.excerpt: I built a URL-to-Markdown endpoint because I wanted to feed arbitrary web pages into agent context windows without stuffing in navbars, cookie banners, and 40 comment threads. The naive version — grab…
articles.body: I built a URL-to-Markdown endpoint because I wanted to feed arbitrary web pages into agent context windows without stuffing in navbars, cookie banners, and 40 comment threads. The naive version — grab the DOM, strip obvious junk, convert — worked great on blog posts and terribly on everything else. The failure mode was subtle: on docs sites and forums, the extractor would confidently return the sidebar as the "main content" because it had more text nodes than the actual article. The output looked plausible, which is worse than failing loudly. My RAG pipeline happily indexed a bunch of navigation links as knowledge. The fix was exposing a CSS selector option so callers can point at exactly the container they mean — article , .post-body , #content — instead of trusting a heuristic.

articles.body: Apa Itu Chain of Recall? Cara Stable ID Memberikan Memori pada Agen AI Chain of Recall adalah cara memberikan memori kepada agen AI yang berjalan lama tanpa harus menjejalkan semuanya ke dalam context window-nya. Setiap Trigger, Thread, dan Worker mendapatkan ID yang stabil. Konteks hanya menyimpan ID, ringkasan singkat, dan pesan-pesan terdekat, lalu agen menelusuri tautan antar-ID untuk mengambil fakta-fakta lama hanya dalam beberapa langkah (hops). Coba Apidog sekarang Istilah ini berasal dari esai desain DeepSeek Harness bertajuk "Exploring Super-agent Design" yang dipublikasikan pada 01-11-2026. Satu catatan penting sebelum Anda melangkah lebih jauh: esai tersebut memaparkan sebuah arsitektur, bukan fitur yang sudah dirilis.

articles.title: invalid_grant: Token has been expired or revoked. Why your Python Google Sheets script dies after 7 days
articles.excerpt: You wrote a Python script that reads or writes a Google Sheet. It ran fine for about a week, then every run started failing with: google.auth.exceptions.RefreshError: ('invalid_grant: Token has been e…
articles.body: You wrote a Python script that reads or writes a Google Sheet. It ran fine for about a week, then every run started failing with: google.auth.exceptions.RefreshError: ('invalid_grant: Token has been expired or revoked.', ...) Nothing in your code changed. Here is why this happens, how to confirm it, and the fix. Why it happens If your script logs in with OAuth (a browser window asks you to click "Allow"), Google gives it a short-lived access token and a long-lived refresh token . gspread saves the refresh token in authorized_user.json . When the refresh token stops working, every run fails with invalid_grant until you do the browser step again.

articles.title: Chain of Recall이란? Stable ID로 AI 에이전트에 기억력을 부여하는 방법

articles.body: Chain of Recall이란? Stable ID로 AI 에이전트에 기억력을 부여하는 방법 Chain of Recall은 컨텍스트 창(Context Window)에 모든 정보를 억지로 밀어 넣지 않고도 장기 실행(Long-running) AI 에이전트에 메모리를 부여하는 방식입니다. 모든 트리거(Trigger), 스레드(Thread), 워커(Worker)는 고유한 불변 ID를 부여받습니다. 컨텍스트에는 ID, 짧은 요약, 인접한 메시지만 유지하며, 에이전트는 ID 간의 연결 링크를 따라가며 몇 번의 홉(hop)만으로 이전 사실을 가져옵니다. 지금 Apidog 사용해 보기 이 용어는 2026년 11월 1일에 게시된 DeepSeek Harness의 설계 에세이 “Exploring Super-agent Design” 에서 비롯되었습니다. 본격적으로 살펴보기 전에 한 가지 유의할 점이 있습니다. 이 에세이에서 설명하는 내용은 정식 출시된 기능이 아니라 아키텍처라는 점입니다. 일부는 저자들이 “DeepSeek의 공식 제품이 아니다”라고 밝힌 프로토타입 플러그인 dsh-superagent-prototype 에 구현되어 있습니다. 즉, 버튼 하나로 켤 수 있는 Chain of Recall 스위치 같은 것은 없으며, 직접 구현해야 하는 설계 패턴입니다. 장기 실행 에이전트에서 발생하는 컨텍스트 창의 한계 장기 실행 에이전트는 작업이 끊임없이 유입되기 때문에 필연적으로 컨텍스트 한계에 부딪힙니다.

articles.body: Chain of Recall Nedir? Stable ID'ler Yapay Zeka Ajanlarına Nasıl Hafıza Kazandırır Chain of Recall, uzun süre çalışan bir yapay zekâ ajanına, bağlam penceresini (context window) her şeyle doldurmak zorunda kalmadan bellek kazandırmanın bir yoludur. Bağlamda yalnızca ID'ler, kısa özetler ve yakın iletiler saklanır; ajan ise daha eski verilere ulaşmak için bu ID'ler arasındaki bağlantıları birkaç adımda izler. Bugün Apidog'u deneyin Bu terim, DeepSeek Harness'ın 01.11.2026 tarihinde yayımlanan "Exploring Super-agent Design" başlıklı tasarım makalesinden geliyor. articles.title: Was ist Chain of Recall? Wie stabile IDs KI-Agenten ein Gedächtnis verleihen
articles.excerpt: Chain of Recall ist ein Ansatz, um langlebigen KI-Agenten ein Gedächtnis zu geben, ohne deren Kontextfenster zu überladen. Jeder Trigger, Thread und Worker erhält eine dauerhafte ID. Im Kontext verble…
articles.body: Chain of Recall ist ein Ansatz, um langlebigen KI-Agenten ein Gedächtnis zu geben, ohne deren Kontextfenster zu überladen. Jeder Trigger, Thread und Worker erhält eine dauerhafte ID. Im Kontext verbleiben lediglich IDs, kurze Zusammenfassungen und benachbarte Nachrichten – der Agent folgt dann den Verknüpfungen zwischen den IDs, um ältere Fakten in wenigen Schritten abzurufen. Testen Sie Apidog noch heute Der Begriff stammt aus dem Design-Essay „Exploring Super-agent Design“ von DeepSeek Harness, der am 01.11.2026 veröffentlicht wurde. Ein wichtiger Hinweis vorab: Der Essay beschreibt eine Architektur, kein fertiges Produktfeature.

articles.title: Hackers used Chrome and Snapdragon GPU flaws to hack Android phones
articles.excerpt: A nasty Chrome bug let hackers break into Android phones without a tap.
articles.body: TL;DR A security firm has found that hackers exploited a Chrome bug and a Qualcomm Adreno GPU driver flaw to infect Android phones that visited a booby-trapped website. The attack targeted Chrome versions 139 to 145 on Android and stole browser cookies, saved logins, browsing history, and Wi-Fi passwords. Both flaws had already been patched, so phones running up-to-date Chrome and security updates remained safe. Security researchers at Sekoia have detailed a mobile hacking campaign that went after Android and iPhone users through hijacked and fake websites. On Android, the attackers didn’t need victims to tap a link, install an app, or grant a permission. Opening an infected page in an outdated version of Chrome was enough.

articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 4, 2015: A rail-launched Super Strypi rocket carrying 13 baby satellites failed during its debut launch for the US Air Force
articles.excerpt: On Nov. 4, 2015, the United States Air Force launched an experimental Super Strypi rail-launched rocket carrying 13 tiny satellites, but it failed just after liftoff from Hawaii.
articles.body: On Nov. 4, 2015, the United States Air Force planned to launch an experimental rocket for small satellites from the Pacific Missile Range Facility off Barking Sands, Kauai, Hawaii. The launch didn't according to plan . For this mission, the Air Force was testing out the Super Strypi rocket . The rocket used a rail to help with the liftoff. Super Strypi left the ground, but the rocket quickly spun out of control. When it crashed, it destroyed all of the tiny satellites riding aboard the rocket. The cause? Likely a problem with the first stage motor. The mission lost 13 tiny satellites known as cubesats. Cubesats are a popular option for space missions, because they are small and cheap, and they often operate in swarms.

articles.title: Hackers exploited iOS and Android flaws to infect phones
articles.excerpt: Researchers say group may have been Kremlin-sponsored in search of diplomatic targets.
articles.body: Hackers possibly linked to the Kremlin exploited previously patched iOS and Android flaws in an attempt to hack visitors of multiple websites, including one celebrating the 250th anniversary of American independence, researchers said Wednesday. The attackers, which the researchers assessed with “moderate to high confidence” were part of Russia’s Foreign Intelligence Service, targeted other sites, many with links to that country’s ongoing war against Ukraine. The attacks began when iPhone or Android users visited one of potentially hundreds of different sites. JavaScript injected into the traffic then profiled the device. The final payloads, tailored to the type of platform visiting, attempted to steal browser cookies and, in some cases, Wi-Fi passwords and full mobile device data.

articles.title: Trump declares 'American space superiority for all eternity' in election night proclamation
articles.excerpt: President Trump has declared space a frontier for all humanity, asserting America's right to develop and settle the solar system under U.S. law.
articles.body: President Trump issued a declaration yesterday (Nov. 3), proclaiming space open to all humanity for exploration, and the right of American citizens to develop and settle the solar system according to United States laws. "The American Declaration of Freedom in Space," describes space as the "province of all humans" and asserts that the United States will lead humanity's expansion into the cosmos. The proclamation reiterates the administration's goals with NASA's Artemis program to return American astronauts to the moon by 2028 and eventually sending astronauts to Mars , but introduces no new funding, programs or policy directives.
